review.note: Reviewed every build/runtime/dev/Node registry candidate, including versions outside declared bounds; all latest candidates satisfy the manifest and accept Python 3.14. Core 0.37.0 changes the ingest source adapter contract only for this consumer: the CatalogReader, publication/domain values, public read-only database opener, config, and epoch-3/schema-version-6 schema used by Komga are unchanged from 0.36.0. The supported range is expanded to >=0.36.0,<0.38.0, retaining the verified lower lane without a shim. Complete offline consumer suite: 83 passed on the published h2hdb 0.36.0 wheel and 83 passed on the published 0.37.0 wheel; real read-only SQLite initialization/open smoke passed on both. Reviewed build 1.6.1 Windows symlink-detection regression fix (https://github.com/pypa/build/blob/1.6.1/CHANGELOG.rst) and Ruff 0.16.7 lint/format fixes and preview additions (https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.16.7); installed both latest tools and passed the fast gate without enabling preview or relaxing checks. All other direct candidates match the previous reviewed audit. Exact merge gate, final wheel requirement/origin/SQLite checks, and whole deployment cohort resolution are separate evidence.
